channel.title: Ikbal Turgut — Writing
channel.description: Independent notes on engineering, systems, and product craft.

item.title: Legibility is a feature, not a finish
item.description: Most complex software fails at the moment of reading, not the moment of computing. Clarity has to be designed into the system, not sprinkled on at the end.

item.title: Spend your novelty budget wisely
item.description: Every project has a limited budget for interesting technical choices. Where you spend it — infrastructure or product — quietly decides how the next year feels.

item.title: Latency budgets are a design tool
item.description: Deciding where your milliseconds go is not just an operations concern. It is one of the earliest and most consequential design decisions you can make.

item.title: Write migrations you can walk back
item.description: Forward-only is a strategy for systems you fully understand. Most of the time, you do not — so build the road back before you drive down it.
